title: TacHarness: VTLA Serving & Evidence Harness
description: Lab-wide serving and conformance harness for Vision-Tactile-Language-Action policies: ModelServer serves any VTLA policy to any tactile simulator or robot through one real-time contract; DataEngine turns native episodes and execution receipts into catalog, lineage, evidence and synchronized replay. Three research lines run on it: meta-action online teacher collection, TacJev distillation, and Tactile-ETA reproduction.
summary: TacHarness 是实验室的 VTLA 策略统一服务与评测框架：ModelServer 用 tacharness.vtla/1 契约把策略接到八个触觉仿真来源或真机（末端统一为 TacClaw DM25PD04），DataEngine 把原生 episode 和执行收据变成可审计的目录、谱系和同步回放。2026-10-27 三位成员的工作树统一进 main（PR #8）。当前三条研究线：bingsheng 的元动作在线教师（Arena smooth 原生成功；10-28 同事式 RoboLab 在线采集六次运行取得三条合格示范）、gujie 的 GPT-6 × TacClaw 采集路线（x4 批 5/7）、TacJev 蒸馏（固定 UniVTAC lift_can 离线流水线跑通，三种子 top-1 0.73–0.96）；Tactile-ETA 已取得一次在线复现成功。待决：outputs/ 证据版本化策略、右触觉垫零接触定位。
asset_alt: TacHarness architecture: ModelServer and DataEngine planes on one evidence spine, with the meta-action online teacher, TacJev distillation and Tactile-ETA reproduction lines on top.
asset_caption: 两个产品平面共用一条证据主干：ModelServer 负责实时服务，DataEngine 负责可追溯回放；三条研究线都通过原生门禁和哈希收据留档。

subprojects.label: A
subprojects.title: Harness core: ModelServer + DataEngine
subprojects.body: Typed VTLA contracts, bounded sessions, content-bound receipts, LeRobot v3 views and replay. Core is component-tested; three-source tactile collection P0 accepted 2026-10-05; PI0.5 three-step online wiring smoke passed 2026-10-08. Physical-robot end-to-end on the same protocol is still pending.
subprojects.output: main@054e567d · 3,648 CPU tests passing · 3 pre-existing failures

subprojects.label: B
subprojects.title: Meta-action online teacher (bingsheng, gujie)
subprojects.body: Show-Harness discrete meta actions driven by a VLM teacher. Arena: full-movement smooth ON native successes and re-validation (10-20); the pure online Arena batch of 10-26 stayed at 0. On 10-28 the colleague-style RoboLab route produced six fresh online runs with two immediate native successes and three qualified demonstrations (full input, no object coordinates, original material), budgets closed and DataEngine readback verified. Next stage: the missing no-coordinates + original-material combination, explicit execution-result feedback to the teacher, and one shared interpreter contract with TacJev.
subprojects.output: 3 qualified online demos (10-28) · next-stage order frozen · right-pad zero-contact under investigation

subprojects.label: C
subprojects.title: TacJev distillation (Jingxiang)
subprojects.body: Qwen3.5-2B LoRA scores a nine-token meta-action vocabulary from two RGB views, two tactile images, instruction and end-effector state. First complete offline run on the pinned 30-episode UniVTAC lift_can set with stop/resume verification and temperature calibration.
subprojects.output: Test top-1 0.729 / 0.789 / 0.958 across split seeds, calibrated ECE 0.198 / 0.116 / 0.019 · PR #9 · online UniVTAC eval next

subprojects.label: D
subprojects.title: Tactile-ETA reproduction → tactile RSI
subprojects.body: Real Codex 0.164 plus the author stdio MCP drove a native Insert Tube loop: one success (v35), one early termination (v34), budget closed. Proposed next: agentic real2sim tactile RSI (align contact timing, compare indentation/deformation/shear, agent tunes an explicit tactile parameter table with receipts) and contact-patch local 3D super-resolution.
subprojects.output: Reproduction report + paper companion published · RSI proposal pending

details: [FRAME] Two product planes, one evidence spine: ModelServer owns real time (handshake/describe/reset/predict/close, deadlines, tactile freshness, action units); DataEngine owns traceability (source identity, episodes, streams, calibration, checkpoints, receipts, synchronized replay) and never actuates a robot.

[KNOWN] [CONFIDENCE: HIGH] Evidence ladder is explicit: declared → importable → component-tested → end-to-end. A directory or a fixture test passing never counts as a real checkpoint, simulator or robot having run.

[KNOWN] [CONFIDENCE: HIGH] 2026-10-27 unification: bingsheng (198 commits), the codex/tacjev branch, and the gujie and huyuxin rollout layers (as git subtrees under contrib/) merged into main via PR #8; full CPU suite 3,648 passed, 22 skipped, 3 pre-existing failures, 1 collection error.

[KNOWN] [CONFIDENCE: HIGH] 2026-10-28 colleague-style online collection: 6 fresh RoboLab runs, 2 immediate native successes, 3 qualified demonstrations (548 / 1193 / 552 frames); 6 launches / 377 HTTP / 9044.61 s wall clock, all four ledgers closed; 3,738 frames rebuilt the native predicate with zero difference, 12 videos decoded, publication readback v2 passes. Single-factor successes do not imply the combined no-coordinates + original-material case.

[KNOWN] [CONFIDENCE: HIGH] Colleague GPT-6 x4 batch is 5/7 (JEMM batch was 0/7). Failure attribution: middle drawer gets no handle coordinate and thrashes 2 cm above the handle with no blocked-move feedback; two-object task loses the can on the post-transport lift and never places it.

[KNOWN] [CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM] Right tactile pad reports zero contact through entire grasps in three Tabero episodes but 532 frames in another; candidate causes are the per-side tactile camera retreat defaults (−2.5 mm left vs −1.0 mm right), the filtered PhysX contact sensor bound only to the right finger, and tactile simulation tracking only declared targets. Localisation experiment needs no model requests.

[FRAME] Evidence policy: outputs/ now holds 46,858 tracked files / 7.85 GB against the layout contract and the GitHub repo grew from 120 MB to 6.5 GB; proposal (PR #11) recommends NAS archive with per-file sha256 manifests in git, no history rewrite.

risks_decisions: [KNOWN] [CONFIDENCE: HIGH] 2026-10-27 decision: keep bingsheng's evidence commits unrewritten (49 evidence files and two notes reference their hashes); push them one commit at a time under the 2 GB GitHub push limit. Policy for new campaigns is PR #11.
[KNOWN] [CONFIDENCE: HIGH] Online teacher line stays with bingsheng's running batch; no second agent spends model-request budget on issues 05/06 until his batch closes.

[INFERRED] [CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM] Right-pad zero contact affects TacJev training data and the dual-pad acceptance gate; until localised, treat 'left pad contact + object lift' as the acceptance signal instead of dual-pad contact.

[FRAME] NAS access from the lab box runs over a WiFi + SMB 2.0 hop at ~4 MB/s with occasional lost writes; large evidence uploads must be chunked and verified by direct read on the NAS side (done for the 47 GB hyx migration).
